title: 불필요한 render pass 종료·재시작 감소
existingWork: E2 descriptor 직접 작성은 패스 병합이 아님. Zink의 상위 종료와 MVK의 image/fragment 경계를 따로 추적해야 함.
missingEvidence: 어느 분할이 중복인지 현재 BAR의 종료 사유·빈도 근거가 부족.

risk.function: 매우 높음: attachment/subresource/load-store/partial clear/query/alias/fragment 소비 의미.
risk.lifetime: 높음: transient backing·visibility buffer·query retirement·중간resolve 수명.
risk.synchronization: 매우 높음: 동일encoder local hazard와 prior-queue producer/consumer를 구분해야 함.
risk.memory: 합쳐진 긴 pass와 backing 생존이 늘거나 오히려 추가 encoder를 만들 수 있음.

strategy: First test Typed frame-local discard (11a), which communicates ended data lifetime upstream. Any later driver pass merge must target one proven redundant boundary and preserve attachment/subresource, load/store, sampling, query, alias and producer-consumer requirements. Never equate E2 descriptor construction with pass merging.
acceptance: 11a readonly/model retention/DSA and actual context checks pass
For broader merging, establish a specific repeated boundary with preserved intermediate observations
Review fallback for every unknown attachment/query/alias case before code
tests: 11a actual StreamBuffer and Typed owner CPU checks plus later real Mesa context
Existing suspend/resolve/visibility/native cases for exact proposed merge
dependencyMeaning: Interactions require re-review; they are not permission to enable all related changes together.
designStage: Exact source capsules where named; broader missing-target/ownership/pass designs remain gated where stated
stopRule: Any unclosed correctness/lifetime counterexample, changed parent, failed check or unclear measurement stops this module. Preserve failure evidence; no automatic replay.
rollback: Prepared source module: exact reverse patch only against its postimage, refresh mtimes and rebuild all affected headers. No-code module: active product remains unchanged; no invented reverse patch.
